slides.sub: How one man invented a sound no one knew they were missing.

text: handed a teenage boy a jazz fusion record.
That boy never came back from it.
All of it lived in the same body.
No name for the genre yet.
Space where the bass usually lived.
October 1994. Mars Bar. Charing Cross Road.
He launched a club night called Speed.
The crowd came to listen, not just to dance.

quote: "Perhaps one of the two most important
slides.note: — Rolling Stone, on Logical Progression (1996). The other was Goldie's Timeless. Two records. Two halves of the same city. One went dark. One went deep.

text: and the scene accelerated into darkness —
Heard the cathedral inside the basement.
He just chose a different frequency.
MC Conrad — his voice at every Speed night —
The music they made together still plays.
In the moment before the beat returns.
